tasks.task: Verify a WooCommerce webhook signature against the exact posted bytes before parsing the JSON.
Dedupe an order.updated webhook when WooCommerce delivers it more than once.
The order.paid handler stored and applied the event and created the fulfillment, but WooCommerce timed out before the 2xx arrived and posted the same event again. Make the retry safe.

The same order.paid webhook is delivered twice at the same moment to two app servers. Each handler looks up the event in the inbox, finds nothing, and applies it, so the order is fulfilled twice. Make the handler idempotent under concurrent duplicates.
